_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro: Ikaw sa pagdula Klondike Solitaire. Ang imong tumong mao ang paglihok sa tanan nga mga kard ngadto sa pundasyon piles. Mga lagda Game: - Foundation piles (F1-F4): Pagtukod gikan Ace ngadto sa King diha sa suit-Tableau piles, T1-T7): Nagtindog ubos alternating kolor (pulaan sa itom, itom sa pula) - Stock: Draw cards to waste pile - Waste (W): Top card anaa alang sa play Commands: - 'draw' - Ibutang ang mga kard gikan sa stock aron sa basura - 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Move cards between piles Pananglitan: 'moliwat W1', 'movable T1 F2 ', 'moved T3 T5 2'. Mahimo usab ihapon 'all,' diin mosulay dayon sa pagbalhin sa tanang nawong up cards. - 'forfeit' - End the game and lock in your current score names - Pile actions: W (was), F41-F4-T1, execute multiple actions (to dispose of red) - Wasten (W). You can be placed on a table with disposal Piles by moving them Example: Use one action only if you believe; If left empty move is missing, use A single turntable Action may be executed.
